title: Rubico Prime
extract:
Rubico Prime is a Primed variant of the revolver-style  Rubico Sniper Rifle, boasting higher damage, critical chance, status chance, fire rate, and reload speed, but with a reduction in zoom. It was released alongside  Chroma Prime and  Gram Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Two zoom modes:
First zoom has 2.5x zoom distance and +35% critical damage multiplier.
Second zoom has 5.0x zoom distance and +50% critical damage multiplier.
Can use the Rubico-exclusive  Ambush Optics mod.
Advantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very high crit chance (38.00%)
High burst DPS (1207.87)
Above average sustained DPS (489.41)
Very high fire rate (3.67 attacks/sec)
High reload speed (2.00 s)
Very high ammo max (72)
Very high crit multiplier (3.00x)
Disadvantages over other Primary  Sniper Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low active falloff slope (400.0m/%)
Low magazine size (5)
Below average total damage (187)
Very low ammo pickup (15)
Very low accuracy (0.00° to 15.00°)
Very low status chance (16.00%)
Very low disposition (●●○○○ (0.70x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Rubico Prime (Normal Attack), compared to  Rubico (Normal Attack):
Higher base damage per projectile (187.00 vs. 180.00)
Higher  Impact damage ( 149.6 vs.  144)
Higher  Puncture damage ( 28.1 vs.  27)
Higher  Slash damage ( 9.3 vs.  9)
Higher total damage (187 vs. 180)
Higher base critical chance (38.00% vs. 30.00%)
Higher base status chance (16.00% vs. 12.00%)
Higher average damage per tap (329.12 vs. 288)
Higher burst DPS (1207.87 vs. 768.96)
Higher sustained DPS (489.41 vs. 337.02)
Higher fire rate (3.67 attacks/sec vs. 2.67 attacks/sec)
Faster reload time (2.00 s vs. 2.40 s)
Higher Mastery Rank required (12 vs. 6)
Lower disposition (●●○○○ (0.70x) vs. ●●●○○ (0.95x))
Lower zoom distance (2.5x/5x vs. 3.5x/6x)
Significantly lessened recoil.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On June 30th, 2020, it was announced that Rubico Prime, alongside  Chroma Prime and  Gram Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on July 14th, 2020. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.

Notes
The Rubico Prime requires only a single shot to activate its Shot Combo Counter, giving it an immediate 1.5x total damage multiplier after the first shot, and a 2.0x total damage multiplier after its third shot, giving it the ability to quickly ramp up its damage with a single magazine. On the other hand, it has a shot counter that decays by 1 shot every 2.0 seconds, thus reloading at 2.0 seconds will always decay the shot combo counter by 1 if there are no reload mods present.
With  Harkonar Scope or Arcane Momentum, it's possible to maintain the Rubico's shot combo counter through reloads.
The combo multiplier starts at 1.5x on the first shot and requires triple the amount of shots to reach each consecutive tier.
Multiplier=1.5+0.5⌊log3(Combo hits)⌋
